description: Check whether a clip job is done and get the finished clips. Use after clip_video to poll (every 30–60s). Clips arrive AS THEY FINISH, so a clips[] array does NOT mean the job is done — it often holds a partial batch. Announce the job as finished ONLY when delivery.complete is true; while it is false, say how many clips (delivery.delivered) are ready so far and keep polling. delivery also carries visible / captionRepair / state. A clip whose delivery_state is "caption_repair" plays but its captions failed, so it is not finished work; "unknown_status" plays too but the server could not classify it, so never call that batch finished. delivery.expected is ADVISORY (the candidate count analysis proposed, often higher than what gets cut) and may be null — never poll against it and never quote it as a target. Present the top clips by viral_score.
name: get_clip_status
